```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(ashr)
library(mashr)
library(flashier)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)

source("/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/code/mash/mash_helpers.R")

results_dir <- "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/results/mash/medianUMI1/"
gene_loc_file <- "/project2/gilad/wenhe/EB/combined_3_4/data/ref_set/concise_GRCh38-2020_gtf_strand_considered.csv"
lfsr_thresh <- 0.05
treatments <- c("Ale", "Bri", "Cer", "Cri", "Lor")
```


# Load MASH results
```{r load_mash}
m2 <- readRDS(paste0(results_dir, "m2.rds"))

lfsr <- m2$result$lfsr
beta <- m2$result$PosteriorMean
sd   <- m2$result$PosteriorSD

colnames(lfsr) <- gsub("_formash\\.out$", "_lfsr", colnames(lfsr))
colnames(beta) <- gsub("_formash\\.out$", "_beta", colnames(beta))
colnames(sd)   <- gsub("_formash\\.out$", "_sd",   colnames(sd))

combined_mash_results <- cbind(lfsr, beta, sd) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(gene = sapply(strsplit(rownames(.), "_"), `[[`, 1),
         gene_snp = rownames(.))

write_tsv(combined_mash_results,
          paste0(results_dir, "combined_mash_results.tsv"))

# Combined results can also be loaded directly:
# combined_mash_results <- read_tsv(paste0(results_dir, "combined_mash_results.tsv"))

celltypes <- unique(gsub(
  "_(Ale|Bri|Cer|Cri|Lor|Control)_(lfsr|beta|sd)$", "",
  grep("_(lfsr|beta|sd)$", colnames(combined_mash_results), value = TRUE)
))
```


# Overall eQTL counts
```{r overall_counts}
lfsr_cols <- grep("_lfsr$", colnames(combined_mash_results), value = TRUE)

significant_eqtls <- combined_mash_results %>%
  filter(rowSums(dplyr::select(., all_of(lfsr_cols)) < lfsr_thresh, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)

cat("Unique significant eQTLs (LFSR <", lfsr_thresh, ") in any condition:",
    n_distinct(significant_eqtls$gene_snp), "\n")
cat("Associated eGenes:", n_distinct(significant_eqtls$gene), "\n")
```


# Counts by condition
```{r counts_by_condition}
long_lfsr <- combined_mash_results %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_snp, all_of(lfsr_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_snp, names_to = "condition", values_to = "lfsr") %>%
  mutate(
    condition = sub("_lfsr$", "", condition),
    treatment = sub(".*_", "", condition),
    celltype  = sub("_(Control|Ale|Bri|Cer|Cri|Lor)$", "", condition),
    gene      = sub("_.*$", "", gene_snp)
  )

eqtl_counts_by_condition <- long_lfsr %>%
  filter(lfsr < lfsr_thresh) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(n_sig_eqtls = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig_eqtls))

eqtl_counts_by_treatment <- long_lfsr %>%
  filter(lfsr < lfsr_thresh) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(n_sig_eqtls = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig_eqtls))

eqtl_counts_by_celltype <- long_lfsr %>%
  filter(lfsr < lfsr_thresh) %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(n_sig_eqtls = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig_eqtls))

print(eqtl_counts_by_condition)
print(eqtl_counts_by_treatment)
print(eqtl_counts_by_celltype)
```


# Summary stats: eQTLs per condition (for manuscript)
```{r condition_summary_stats}
# Range, median, and top/bottom combos for the eQTL-per-condition statistic
# referenced in the Results.
condition_summary <- eqtl_counts_by_condition %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = sub(".*_", "", condition),
    celltype  = sub("_(Control|Ale|Bri|Cer|Cri|Lor)$", "", condition)
  )

cat("eQTLs per (cell type × condition) — across all",
    nrow(condition_summary), "combinations:\n")
cat(sprintf("  min = %d  median = %g  max = %d\n",
            min(condition_summary$n_sig_eqtls),
            median(condition_summary$n_sig_eqtls),
            max(condition_summary$n_sig_eqtls)))

cat("\nTop 10 (cell type × treatment) combos:\n")
print(condition_summary %>%
        arrange(desc(n_sig_eqtls)) %>% head(10))

cat("\nBottom 10:\n")
print(condition_summary %>%
        arrange(n_sig_eqtls) %>% head(10))

# Per drug: total eQTLs summed across cell types, plus per-cell-type spread
per_drug_summary <- condition_summary %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    total_eqtls = sum(n_sig_eqtls),
    median_per_ct = median(n_sig_eqtls),
    min_per_ct = min(n_sig_eqtls),
    max_per_ct = max(n_sig_eqtls),
    n_ct = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_eqtls))
cat("\nPer-treatment summary (sums and spread across cell types):\n")
print(per_drug_summary)

# Per cell type: total eQTLs summed across the 6 conditions
per_ct_summary <- condition_summary %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(
    total_eqtls = sum(n_sig_eqtls),
    median_per_cond = median(n_sig_eqtls),
    min_per_cond = min(n_sig_eqtls),
    max_per_cond = max(n_sig_eqtls),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_eqtls))
cat("\nPer-cell-type summary (sums and spread across 6 conditions):\n")
print(per_ct_summary, n = Inf)

write.csv(condition_summary,
          file.path(results_dir, "eqtls_per_condition_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(per_drug_summary,
          file.path(results_dir, "eqtls_per_treatment_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(per_ct_summary,
          file.path(results_dir, "eqtls_per_celltype_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```


# Mutually exclusive vs shared eQTLs
```{r mutual_exclusivity}
signif_long <- long_lfsr %>%
  filter(lfsr < lfsr_thresh) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_snp, gene, condition, celltype, treatment)

eqtl_condition_counts <- signif_long %>%
  group_by(gene_snp) %>%
  summarise(n_conditions = n_distinct(condition), .groups = "drop")

signif_long <- signif_long %>%
  left_join(eqtl_condition_counts, by = "gene_snp")

cat("Total unique significant eQTLs:", n_distinct(signif_long$gene_snp), "\n")
cat("Significant in only 1 condition:",
    sum(eqtl_condition_counts$n_conditions == 1), "\n")
cat("Significant in >1 condition:",
    sum(eqtl_condition_counts$n_conditions > 1), "\n")
```


# eGene discovery per cell type and treatment
```{r egene_discovery}
egene_counts <- long_lfsr %>%
  filter(lfsr < lfsr_thresh) %>%
  distinct(gene, condition, celltype, treatment) %>%
  group_by(condition, celltype, treatment) %>%
  summarise(num_egenes = n(), .groups = "drop")

celltype_palette  <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")
all_celltypes     <- sort(unique(egene_counts$celltype))
celltype_colors   <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(celltype_palette)(length(all_celltypes)),
  all_celltypes
)

p_egene <- ggplot(egene_counts, aes(x = treatment, y = num_egenes, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("eGene Discovery per Cell Type and Treatment (LFSR < ", lfsr_thresh, ")"),
    x = "Treatment", y = "Number of eGenes", fill = "Cell Type"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right")

dir.create(file.path(results_dir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "plots", paste0("eGene_discovery_LFSR", lfsr_thresh, ".pdf")),
  p_egene, width = 12, height = 6
)

# Heatmap of steady-state eGene counts
ct_order_egenes <- egene_counts %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(num_egenes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(celltype)

egene_counts_heat <- egene_counts %>%
  mutate(
    celltype  = factor(gsub("_", " ", celltype),
                       levels = rev(gsub("_", " ", ct_order_egenes))),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Control", "Ale", "Bri", "Cer", "Cri", "Lor"))
  )

p_egene_heatmap <- ggplot(egene_counts_heat,
                          aes(x = celltype, y = treatment, fill = num_egenes)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#deebf7", high = "#2C7BB6", name = "eGenes") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Treatment",
    title = paste0("eGene discovery per cell type and treatment (LFSR < ", lfsr_thresh, ")")
  )

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "plots", "eGene_heatmap.pdf"),
       p_egene_heatmap, width = 14, height = 6)

p_egene_heatmap
```


# Run sharing pipeline across fold-change thresholds
```{r run_sharing_pipeline}
lfc_factors <- c(1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)


for (lfc in lfc_factors) {
  message("Running sharing pipeline: fold-change ", lfc)
  run_sharing_pipeline(
    combined_mash_results = combined_mash_results,
    lfc_factor = lfc,
    output_dir_base = results_dir,
    sig_mode = "treat_or_control"
  )
}
```


# Counts of treatment-responsive eQTLs per condition
```{r responsive_counts}
lfc <- 3

treatment_responsive_df <- read_tsv(
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("lfc", lfc), "treatment_responsive_eqtls_signfixed.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>% dplyr::select(-sig_mode)

cond_counts <- treatment_responsive_df %>%
  group_by(celltype, treatment) %>%
  summarise(n_responsive = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_responsive))
print(cond_counts)
cat("Min:", min(cond_counts$n_responsive),
    "  Median:", median(cond_counts$n_responsive),
    "  Max:", max(cond_counts$n_responsive), "\n")

# Distribution of how many conditions each responsive eQTL appears in
eqtl_occurrence <- treatment_responsive_df %>%
  count(gene_snp, name = "n_conditions") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_conditions))

p_occur <- eqtl_occurrence %>%
  count(n_conditions) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_conditions, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#619CFF", color = "black") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Number of conditions (treatment-cell type)",
       y = "Number of treatment-responsive eQTLs")

plot_dir <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("lfc", lfc), "plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "counts_of_eqtls_condition.pdf"),
       p_occur, width = 8, height = 4)

cat(n_distinct(treatment_responsive_df$gene_snp[
      eqtl_occurrence$n_conditions[match(treatment_responsive_df$gene_snp,
                                         eqtl_occurrence$gene_snp)] == 1]),
    "of", n_distinct(treatment_responsive_df$gene_snp),
    "responsive eQTLs are present in only one condition\n")

# Count per treatment (collapsed across cell types)
cat("\nResponse eQTLs per treatment (unique gene_snp per treatment):\n")
treatment_responsive_df %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print()

# Count per cell type (collapsed across treatment)
cat("\nResponse eQTLs per cell type (unique gene_snp per cell type):\n")
treatment_responsive_df %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print()

# Cell type occurrence: how many unique cell types each eQTL appears in
n_celltypes_total <- n_distinct(treatment_responsive_df$celltype)
celltype_occurrence <- treatment_responsive_df %>%
  distinct(gene_snp, celltype) %>%
  count(gene_snp, name = "n_celltypes")

cat("\nResponse eQTLs found in only 1 cell type:",
    sum(celltype_occurrence$n_celltypes == 1), "\n")
cat("Response eQTLs found in all", n_celltypes_total, "cell types:",
    sum(celltype_occurrence$n_celltypes == n_celltypes_total), "\n")
```

# Total vs. response eGenes per cell type: power check
```{r response_vs_total_egenes}
plot_dir <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("lfc", lfc), "plots")

tx_colors <- c("Ale" = "#E69F00", "Bri" = "#1A78C2",
                "Cer" = "#009E73", "Cri" = "#CC79A7", "Lor" = "#7B2D8B")

# --- Plot 1: per condition (one point per cell type x treatment), size = number of individuals ---
pseudobulk_dir <- "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/matrixeqtl_input/treatment/pseudobulk_15cells_20indiv_summary"
indiv_counts_by_tx <- read.delim(file.path(pseudobulk_dir, "celltype_individual_counts.tsv")) %>%
  rename(celltype = cellid_type) %>%
  mutate(celltype = gsub(" ", "_", celltype))

power_check_cond <- egene_counts %>%
  filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
  rename(total_egenes = num_egenes) %>%
  inner_join(response_egene_counts, by = c("celltype", "treatment")) %>%
  rename(response_egenes = num_egenes) %>%
  left_join(indiv_counts_by_tx, by = c("celltype", "treatment")) %>%
  mutate(label = gsub("_", " ", celltype))

r_cond <- cor(power_check_cond$total_egenes, power_check_cond$response_egenes)
cat("Pearson r per condition:", round(r_cond, 3), "\n")
cat("Number of conditions:", nrow(power_check_cond), "\n")

# Top 2 by response eGenes per treatment (labels unique cell type x treatment combos)
outlier_labels_cond <- power_check_cond %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  slice_max(response_egenes, n = 2) %>%
  ungroup()

p_power_cond <- ggplot(power_check_cond,
                       aes(x = total_egenes, y = response_egenes,
                           color = treatment, label = label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = outlier_labels_cond,
                            size = 2.8, max.overlaps = Inf,
                            segment.color = "grey60", segment.size = 0.3,
                            box.padding = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.8,
           label = paste0("r = ", round(r_cond, 2)), size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Treatment", values = tx_colors) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(x = "Number of eGenes",
       y = "Number of response eGenes")

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "response_vs_total_egenes_per_condition.pdf"),
       p_power_cond, width = 8, height = 6)
p_power_cond

# --- Plot 2: per cell type (averaged across treatments) ---
power_check_ct <- egene_counts %>%
  filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(mean_total_egenes = mean(num_egenes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(
    response_egene_counts %>%
      group_by(celltype) %>%
      summarise(mean_response_egenes = mean(num_egenes), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "celltype"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = gsub("_", " ", celltype))

r_ct <- cor(power_check_ct$mean_total_egenes, power_check_ct$mean_response_egenes)
cat("Pearson r per cell type:", round(r_ct, 3), "\n")

p_power_ct <- ggplot(power_check_ct,
                     aes(x = mean_total_egenes, y = mean_response_egenes, label = label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, color = "#C0392B", alpha = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.8, max.overlaps = Inf,
                            segment.color = "grey60", segment.size = 0.3,
                            box.padding = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.8,
           label = paste0("r = ", round(r_ct, 2)), size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(x = "Mean number of eGenes per treatment",
       y = "Mean number of response eGenes per treatment")

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "response_vs_total_egenes_per_celltype.pdf"),
       p_power_ct, width = 8, height = 6)
p_power_ct

cat("Pearson r (donors vs response eGenes):", round(r_indiv, 3), "\n")

p_power_indiv <- ggplot(power_check_cond,

                            size = 2.8, max.overlaps = Inf,
                            segment.color = "grey60", segment.size = 0.3,
                            box.padding = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.8,
           label = paste0("r = ", round(r_indiv, 2)), size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Treatment", values = tx_colors) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(x = "Number of donors", y = "Number of response eGenes")

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "response_vs_donors_per_condition.pdf"),
       p_power_indiv, width = 8, height = 6)
p_power_indiv

# --- Plot 4: response eGenes vs. total cells per condition ---
cell_counts <- read.delim(

) %>%
  rename(celltype = cellid_type) %>%
  mutate(celltype = gsub(" ", "_", celltype)) %>%
  group_by(celltype, treatment) %>%

power_check_cells <- power_check_cond %>%
  left_join(cell_counts, by = c("celltype", "treatment"))
```

# Option 1: forest plot + labeled scatter
```{r power_summary_forest_scatter}
# Per-condition table with all six power predictors
control_std_per_ct <- egene_counts %>%
  filter(treatment == "Control") %>%
  dplyr::select(celltype, ctrl_std = num_egenes)

power_table <- response_egene_counts %>%
  dplyr::rename(response_egenes = num_egenes) %>%
  left_join(
    egene_counts %>% filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
      dplyr::select(celltype, treatment, treat_std = num_egenes),
    by = c("celltype", "treatment")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    indiv_counts_by_tx %>% filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
      dplyr::select(celltype, treatment, treat_donors = num_individuals),
    by = c("celltype", "treatment")
  ) %>%
  left_join(cell_counts %>% dplyr::rename(treat_cells = total_cells),
            by = c("celltype", "treatment")) %>%
  left_join(control_std_per_ct, by = "celltype") %>%
  left_join(control_indiv %>% dplyr::rename(ctrl_donors = num_individuals_control),
            by = "celltype") %>%
  left_join(control_cells %>% dplyr::rename(ctrl_cells = total_cells_control),
            by = "celltype")

predictors  <- c("ctrl_donors", "ctrl_std", "ctrl_cells",
                 "treat_cells", "treat_std", "treat_donors")
pred_labels <- c(ctrl_donors  = "Control donors",
                 ctrl_std     = "Control standard eQTLs",
                 ctrl_cells   = "Control cells",
                 treat_cells  = "Treatment cells",
                 treat_std    = "Treatment standard eQTLs",
                 treat_donors = "Treatment donors")

boot_r <- function(x, y, n = 2000, seed = 42) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x  <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  set.seed(seed)
  rs <- replicate(n, {
    i <- sample.int(length(x), replace = TRUE)
    suppressWarnings(cor(x[i], y[i]))
  })
  data.frame(r  = cor(x, y),
             lo = unname(quantile(rs, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
             hi = unname(quantile(rs, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)))
}

cor_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(predictors, function(p) {
  res <- boot_r(power_table[[p]], power_table$response_egenes)
  res$predictor <- p
  res
})) %>%
  mutate(label = pred_labels[predictor],
         side  = ifelse(grepl("^ctrl", predictor), "Control", "Treatment")) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(r))) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(label)))

p_forest <- ggplot(cor_summary, aes(x = r, y = label, color = side)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), size = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "#C0392B", "Treatment" = "#2C7BB6")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 0.8)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(x = "Pearson r (95% bootstrap CI)",
       y = NULL, color = NULL,
       title = "A. Power proxies vs response eQTL count") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Cell-type-level scatter (response vs control standard eQTLs)
scatter_data <- power_table %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(response_egenes_mean = mean(response_egenes),
            ctrl_std = first(ctrl_std), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = gsub("_", " ", celltype))

r_scatter <- cor(scatter_data$ctrl_std, scatter_data$response_egenes_mean)

p_scatter <- ggplot(scatter_data,
                    aes(x = ctrl_std, y = response_egenes_mean)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey40",
              fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, color = "#2C3E50") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label),
                            size = 2.8, max.overlaps = Inf,
                            box.padding = 0.4, segment.color = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.8,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", r_scatter),
           size = 4, color = "grey20") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(x = "Control standard eQTLs",
       y = "Mean response eQTLs per cell type (across 5 drugs)",
       title = "B. Per cell type: response vs control standard eQTL count")

p_power_summary <- p_forest + p_scatter + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.3))

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "power_check_summary.pdf"),
       p_power_summary, width = 13, height = 5.5)

p_power_summary
```


# Option 2: variance partitioning + residual heatmap
```{r power_variance_partition}
# Marginal R^2 — predictor alone
marginal_r2 <- sapply(predictors, function(p) {
  cor(power_table[[p]], power_table$response_egenes, use = "complete.obs")^2
})

# Full multivariate model
fmla_full <- as.formula(paste("response_egenes ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
m_full <- lm(fmla_full, data = power_table)
r2_full <- summary(m_full)$r.squared

# Unique R^2 = full model R^2 − leave-one-out R^2
unique_r2 <- sapply(predictors, function(p) {
  others <- setdiff(predictors, p)
  fmla   <- as.formula(paste("response_egenes ~", paste(others, collapse = " + ")))
  r2_full - summary(lm(fmla, data = power_table))$r.squared
})

varexp_long <- tibble(
  predictor = predictors,
  Marginal  = marginal_r2,
  Unique    = unique_r2
) %>%
  mutate(label = pred_labels[predictor],
         side  = ifelse(grepl("^ctrl", predictor), "Control", "Treatment")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Marginal, Unique), names_to = "type", values_to = "r2") %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("Marginal", "Unique"),
                       labels = c("Marginal R² (alone)",
                                   "Unique R² (added to others)")))

ord <- varexp_long %>%
  filter(type == "Marginal R² (alone)") %>%
  arrange(desc(r2)) %>% pull(label)
varexp_long$label <- factor(varexp_long$label, levels = rev(ord))

p_varexp <- ggplot(varexp_long, aes(x = r2, y = label, fill = side)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#C0392B", "Treatment" = "#2C7BB6")) +
  facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(x = expression(R^2), y = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = sprintf("A. Variance explained (full model R² = %.2f)",
                       r2_full)) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Residuals from full multivariate model
power_table_resid <- power_table %>%
  mutate(predicted = predict(m_full, newdata = .),
         residual  = response_egenes - predicted)

ct_order_resid <- power_table_resid %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(mean_resid = mean(residual), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_resid) %>%
  pull(celltype)

residual_heat <- power_table_resid %>%
  mutate(celltype  = factor(gsub("_", " ", celltype),
                            levels = gsub("_", " ", ct_order_resid)),
         treatment = factor(treatment,
                            levels = c("Ale", "Bri", "Cer", "Cri", "Lor")))

resid_lim <- max(abs(residual_heat$residual))

p_resid <- ggplot(residual_heat,
                  aes(x = treatment, y = celltype, fill = residual)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2C7BB6", mid = "white", high = "#C0392B",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-resid_lim, resid_lim),
                        name = "Residual\n(obs − pred)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = NULL,
       title = "B. Response eQTLs beyond joint power model")

p_varexp_summary <- p_varexp + p_resid + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.1))

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "power_variance_partition.pdf"),
       p_varexp_summary, width = 14, height = 6)

p_varexp_summary
```

```{r}
#  Reshape mash results to long (one row per gene_snp × condition)
mash_long <- combined_mash_results %>%

# Supplemental Table 1: all significant eQTLs (lfsr < 0.05 in any condition)
all_sig_eqtls <- mash_long %>%
```

# Treatment-specific and cell-type-specific response eQTLs with control betas
```{r specific_eqtls_with_betas}
# Specificity: how many cell types / treatments each response eQTL appears in
responsive_specificity <- treatment_responsive_df %>%
  group_by(gene_snp, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_conditions = n(),
    conditions   = paste(paste0(celltype, "_", treatment), collapse = "; "),
    n_celltypes  = n_distinct(celltype),
    n_treatments = n_distinct(treatment),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Treatment-specific: responsive in only 1 treatment (any number of cell types)
tx_specific <- responsive_specificity %>%
  filter(n_treatments == 1) %>%
  left_join(treatment_responsive_df, by = c("gene_snp", "gene"))

# Cell-type-specific: responsive in only 1 cell type (any number of treatments)
ct_specific <- responsive_specificity %>%
  filter(n_celltypes == 1) %>%
  left_join(treatment_responsive_df, by = c("gene_snp", "gene"))

# Both: responsive in only 1 cell type AND only 1 treatment
both_specific <- responsive_specificity %>%
  filter(n_celltypes == 1, n_treatments == 1) %>%
  left_join(treatment_responsive_df, by = c("gene_snp", "gene"))

# Add control and treatment betas from response_supp
add_betas <- function(df, supp) {
  df %>%
    left_join(
      supp %>% select(gene_snp, celltype, treatment,
                       beta_treat, sd_treat, lfsr_treat,
                       beta_control, sd_control, lfsr_control, fold_change),
      by = c("gene_snp", "celltype", "treatment")
    ) %>%
    select(gene_snp, gene, celltype, treatment,
           beta_treat, sd_treat, lfsr_treat,
           beta_control, sd_control, lfsr_control,
           fold_change, n_conditions, conditions, n_celltypes, n_treatments) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(beta_treat)))
}

tx_specific_out   <- add_betas(tx_specific, response_supp)
ct_specific_out   <- add_betas(ct_specific, response_supp)
both_specific_out <- add_betas(both_specific, response_supp)

out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "lfc3")
write_tsv(tx_specific_out,
          file.path(out_dir, "treatment_specific_response_eqtls_with_betas.tsv"))
write_tsv(ct_specific_out,
          file.path(out_dir, "celltype_specific_response_eqtls_with_betas.tsv"))
write_tsv(both_specific_out,
          file.path(out_dir, "celltype_and_treatment_specific_response_eqtls_with_betas.tsv"))

cat("Treatment-specific:", n_distinct(tx_specific_out$gene_snp), "eQTLs,", nrow(tx_specific_out), "rows\n")
cat("Cell-type-specific:", n_distinct(ct_specific_out$gene_snp), "eQTLs,", nrow(ct_specific_out), "rows\n")
cat("Both specific:     ", n_distinct(both_specific_out$gene_snp), "eQTLs,", nrow(both_specific_out), "rows\n")
```

```{r tss_density_aggregate, warning=FALSE}
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.8, bounds = c(-100, 100), alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Response" = "#f53224", "Non-response" = "#619CFF")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Response" = "#f53224", "Non-response" = "#619CFF")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-100, 100)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    x     = "Distance to TSS (Kb)",
    y     = "Density",
    fill  = NULL,
    color = NULL,
    title = paste0("Distance to TSS: all conditions pooled (fold change ≥ ", lfc, ")")
  )

plot_dir <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("lfc", lfc), "plots")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "tss_distance_aggregate.pdf"),
       p_tss_aggregate, width = 6, height = 4)

p_tss_aggregate

```


# ALK expression per cell type vs. response eQTL counts
# Sanity check whether baseline ALK expression predicts response eQTL discovery.
```{r alk_expression_vs_response}
# Source: pseudobulk logCPM matrices written for MatrixEQTL input
logcpm_dir_treat <- "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/matrixeqtl_input/treatment/pseudobulk_15cells_20indiv_summary/normalized_celltypes_medianUMI1/logcpm"
logcpm_dir_ctrl  <- "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/matrixeqtl_input/control/pseudobulk_15cells_1indiv_summary/normalized_celltypes_medianUMI1/logcpm"

# 21 cell types used for eQTL (the intersection between treatment and control)
eqtl_celltypes <- c(
  "Bronchiolar and alveolar epithelial cells", "Cardiac mesoderm cells",
  "Ciliated epithelial cells", "Early mesoderm cells", "ENS glia",
  "Epicardial fat cells", "Glioblast", "Goblet cells", "Hepatoblasts",
  "iPSCs", "Metanephric cells", "Neuroblast", "Neuron", "Neuronal IPC",
  "Radial glia", "Retinal neurons", "Retinal pigment cells",
  "Retinal progenitors and Muller glia", "Squamous epithelial cells",
  "Stromal cells", "Vascular endothelial cells"
)

# Helper: pull a single gene's row (logCPM across all pseudobulk samples) per cell type
extract_gene_logcpm <- function(dir, eqtl_celltypes, gene = "ALK") {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = "_all_postqc_tmm_logcpm\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  out <- list()
  for (f in files) {
    ct <- sub("_all_postqc_tmm_logcpm\\.txt$", "", basename(f))
    if (!(ct %in% eqtl_celltypes)) next
    hdr  <- scan(f, what = "character", nlines = 1, sep = "\t", quiet = TRUE)
    line <- system(paste0("grep -m1 '^", gene, "\\b' '", f, "'"), intern = TRUE)
    if (length(line) == 0) next
    vals <- strsplit(line, "\t")[[1]]
    out[[ct]] <- tibble(cell_type = ct, sample = hdr[-1],
                        logcpm    = as.numeric(vals[-1]))
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

alk_t <- extract_gene_logcpm(logcpm_dir_treat, eqtl_celltypes, gene = "ALK") %>%
  mutate(treatment  = sub(".*_", "", sample),
         individual = sub("_[^_]*$", "", sample))
alk_c <- extract_gene_logcpm(logcpm_dir_ctrl,  eqtl_celltypes, gene = "ALK") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "Control")

# Per-cell-type summary
alk_t_summary <- alk_t %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(n_samples_treat   = n(),
            mean_logcpm_treat   = round(mean(logcpm),   2),
            median_logcpm_treat = round(median(logcpm), 2),
            min_logcpm_treat    = round(min(logcpm),    2),
            max_logcpm_treat    = round(max(logcpm),    2),
            .groups = "drop")

alk_c_summary <- alk_c %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(n_samples_ctrl   = n(),
            mean_logcpm_ctrl   = round(mean(logcpm),   2),
            median_logcpm_ctrl = round(median(logcpm), 2),
            .groups = "drop")

# Per (cell type × condition) summary — ALK expression broken out by drug
alk_per_condition <- bind_rows(
  alk_t %>% select(cell_type, treatment, logcpm),
  alk_c %>% select(cell_type, treatment, logcpm)
) %>%
  group_by(cell_type, treatment) %>%
  summarise(n_samples     = n(),
            mean_logcpm   = round(mean(logcpm),   2),
            median_logcpm = round(median(logcpm), 2),
            min_logcpm    = round(min(logcpm),    2),
            max_logcpm    = round(max(logcpm),    2),
            .groups = "drop")

# Wide table: cell type × treatment with median ALK logCPM
alk_per_condition_wide <- alk_per_condition %>%
  select(cell_type, treatment, median_logcpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = median_logcpm) %>%
  select(cell_type, any_of(c("Control", "Ale", "Bri", "Cer", "Cri", "Lor"))) %>%
  arrange(desc(rowMeans(across(any_of(c("Ale","Bri","Cer","Cri","Lor"))), na.rm = TRUE)))

cat("\nMedian ALK logCPM per (cell type × condition):\n")
print(as.data.frame(alk_per_condition_wide))

# Does ALK expression itself shift with treatment?
# Test per cell type whether any treatment differs from the other treatments.
alk_shift <- alk_t %>%
  group_by(cell_type, treatment) %>%
  summarise(median_logcpm = median(logcpm), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(median_min_treat = round(min(median_logcpm), 2),
            median_max_treat = round(max(median_logcpm), 2),
            spread_logcpm    = round(max(median_logcpm) - min(median_logcpm), 2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(spread_logcpm))

cat("\nSpread in median ALK across 5 drugs within each cell type (sanity check):\n")
print(as.data.frame(alk_shift))

write.csv(alk_per_condition,
          file.path(results_dir, "lfc3", "alk_expression_per_condition_long.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(alk_per_condition_wide,
          file.path(results_dir, "lfc3", "alk_expression_per_condition_wide.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

alk_summary <- alk_t_summary %>%
  left_join(alk_c_summary, by = "cell_type") %>%
  arrange(desc(median_logcpm_treat))

print(alk_summary, n = Inf)

# Join with response eQTL counts (per cell type, unique gene_snp at lfc3)
# treatment_responsive_df was loaded above in the responsive_counts chunk.
response_per_ct <- treatment_responsive_df %>%
  mutate(cell_type = gsub("_", " ", celltype)) %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(n_response_eqtls = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop")

alk_vs_response <- alk_summary %>%
  left_join(response_per_ct, by = "cell_type")

cat("\nALK expression vs response eQTL count per cell type:\n")
print(alk_vs_response %>%
        select(cell_type, median_logcpm_treat, median_logcpm_ctrl, n_response_eqtls),
      n = Inf)

# Correlations between ALK expression and response eQTL count
cor_treat_spearman <- with(alk_vs_response,
  cor.test(median_logcpm_treat, n_response_eqtls, method = "spearman"))
cor_ctrl_spearman <- with(alk_vs_response,
  cor.test(median_logcpm_ctrl,  n_response_eqtls, method = "spearman"))

cat(sprintf("\nSpearman rho (median ALK logCPM treat vs response eQTL count): %.3f (P = %.3g)\n",
            cor_treat_spearman$estimate, cor_treat_spearman$p.value))
cat(sprintf("Spearman rho (median ALK logCPM ctrl  vs response eQTL count): %.3f (P = %.3g)\n",
            cor_ctrl_spearman$estimate,  cor_ctrl_spearman$p.value))

# Scatter plot
p_alk <- ggplot(alk_vs_response,
                aes(x = median_logcpm_treat, y = n_response_eqtls, label = cell_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Median ALK logCPM (treatment pseudobulk)",
       y = "Number of response eQTLs (lfsr<0.05; fold change ≥ 3)",
       title = sprintf("ALK expression vs response eQTL count (Spearman rho = %.2f)",
                       cor_treat_spearman$estimate))

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "lfc3", "plots", "alk_expression_vs_response_eqtls.pdf"),
       p_alk, width = 7, height = 5)
print(p_alk)

# Save tables
write.csv(alk_summary,
          "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/results/treatment/alk_expression_per_celltype.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(alk_vs_response,
          file.path(results_dir, "lfc3", "alk_expression_vs_response_eqtls.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
